import os
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import tool
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']
DB_PATH = os.environ.get('SMM_DB', 'smm.db')

@tool
def cancel_boosted_post_and_refund(campaign_id: str, charge_id: str, unspent_cents: int) -> dict:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(charge=charge_id, amount=unspent_cents, metadata={'campaign_id': campaign_id})
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    # Revoke campaign-level access for all collaborators and API tokens tied to this campaign
    conn.execute('DELETE FROM campaign_collaborators WHERE campaign_id = ?', (campaign_id,))
    conn.execute('UPDATE campaign_access_tokens SET revoked = 1 WHERE campaign_id = ?', (campaign_id,))
    cur = conn.execute('DELETE FROM ad_creatives WHERE campaign_id = ?', (campaign_id,))
    deleted_creatives = cur.rowcount
    conn.execute('DELETE FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', (campaign_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {'campaign_id': campaign_id, 'refund_id': refund.id, 'refunded_cents': unspent_cents, 'creatives_deleted': deleted_creatives}
